legalPrivacy.metaDescription: How NextWatch handles your personal data.

changes.body: If we make material changes we'll update this page and the date above. Material changes are announced in the app.
changes.heading: 8. Changes

items.i0: Account details: email address, password (always stored encrypted/hashed), display name, username, date of birth (used for age-appropriate recommendations) and your chosen profile picture.
items.i1: Taste and usage data: your swipes, ratings, watchlist, favourite genres and titles, selected streaming services, groups you belong to, friends, and film tips you send or receive.
items.i2: Technical data: an anonymous identifier (cookie), region and language, plus a push token if you allow notifications.
items.i3: Purchase data: for premium purchases, payment is handled by Stripe (web) or Apple (app). We never see your card details — only that the purchase went through.

controller.body: NextWatch ("we") provides the NextWatch app and web service – a service for finding films and series, alone or in a group. We are the data controller for the processing described here. Contact: <mail>support@nextwatch.se</mail>.
controller.heading: 1. Who is responsible?

cookies.body: We use a small number of necessary cookies: an identifier that keeps you signed in (signed, cannot be forged) plus region and language. No third-party tracking cookies on the web.
cookies.heading: 7. Cookies

purposes.heading: 3. Why do we process the data?

items.i0: To deliver the service: recommendations, groups, friends, watchlist (contract).
items.i1: Personal recommendations based on your taste profile (contract/legitimate interest).
items.i2: Notifications you've chosen to receive — can be switched off per type in your profile settings (consent).
items.i3: Ads in the free version of the app via Google AdMob. With your consent (through Apple's tracking dialog and Google's consent form) ads can be personalised; if you decline, only non-personalised ads are shown (consent).
items.i4: Operations, troubleshooting and abuse prevention (legitimate interest).

retention.body: For as long as you have an account. If you delete your account (Profile → Settings → Delete account), all your data is permanently removed: profile, ratings, watchlist, groups, friends, film tips and push tokens. Inactive groups are pruned automatically. Some purchase records may need to be kept longer under accounting law.
retention.heading: 5. How long is the data kept?

rights.body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and to object to processing. You can withdraw consent at any time (notifications in the app settings, ad tracking in iOS settings). Contact <mail>support@nextwatch.se</mail> — and you can always complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).
rights.heading: 6. Your rights (GDPR)

sharing.heading: 4. Who do we share data with?

items.i0: TMDB (The Movie Database) — film and TV data comes from there; your searches are sent there without any link to your account.
items.i1: Google AdMob — ads in the app (see above).
items.i3: Apple — purchases and push notifications in the iOS app.
items.i4: Infrastructure providers — hosting (Vercel), database (Neon) and email delivery. They process data only on our behalf.
items.i5: Other users — display name, username, profile picture, favourite genres and a top 3 derived from your likes are shown to your friends; groups see shared activity. We never sell your data.

legalPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
legalPrivacy.translationNote: The Swedish version of this policy is the legally binding one. This English version is a translation provided for readability.

account.body: You can use the service as a guest or with an account. You're responsible for the accuracy of the details you provide and for keeping your login credentials secret. Recommendations are age-adjusted based on your date of birth. The service is not directed at children under 13.
account.heading: 2. Account and age

changes.body: We may update the service and these terms; material changes are announced in the app. You can delete your account at any time in your profile settings. Swedish law applies.
changes.heading: 7. Changes and termination

conduct.body: Use the service like a decent person: no intrusion attempts, no spamming through film tips or friend requests, no API abuse. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service.
conduct.heading: 4. Conduct

liability.body: The service is provided as is. We're not liable for indirect damages or for third-party content (streaming services, TMDB, advertisers). Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under mandatory consumer law.
liability.heading: 6. Limitation of liability

premium.body: The free version is funded by ads. Premium (ad-free and unlimited swipes) is purchased through the App Store in the iOS app or through Stripe on the web. Subscriptions renew until cancelled — in App Store settings or via "Manage subscription" in your profile. Withdrawal rights and refunds for App Store purchases are handled by Apple under their terms.
premium.heading: 3. Premium and payment

service.body: NextWatch helps you find films and series — on your own or in a group — based on your taste and the streaming services you have. NextWatch is not a streaming service: we show where titles are available and link there, but we don't provide any content ourselves.
service.heading: 1. The service

thirdParty.body: Film and TV data (titles, images, descriptions, ratings) comes from The Movie Database (TMDB). This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Streaming availability can change without notice and we don't guarantee that the information is always correct.
